_comment: our own quality gate. scripts/quality-gate.mjs checks SonarCloud results against these after every scan and fails the build if any is broken. vulnerabilities are tracked here but gated in the Security stage, since this stage is about code health

duplicated_lines_density.why: copy paste means fixing bugs twice

sqale_rating.why: maintainability rating must be A (1 = A, 5 = E)

code_smells.why: cap on tech debt so it cant quietly pile up
